title_zh: 确认桌游中交出角色卡的条件

scenario.label_zh: 桌游间谍角色的交卡规则
scenario.goal_zh: 核对被发现后的角色规则并决定保留本轮角色卡

context_zh: 朋友 Jules 与 Hana 正在玩一款虚构桌游，并查阅该游戏自定规则。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I’m a spy this round. If someone discovers me, do I have to surrender my character card?

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Not immediately. Our standing rule is that you keep it unless you lose the next challenge.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I thought being discovered meant I was out.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: That was the practice round. Look, the note for the main game gives you one more challenge.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Right. I’ll keep my card and play the challenge.

sentences.speaker: Hana
sentences.text: Exactly. You’re still in the game for now.
